tasks.behavior: A merchant profile's members reach only what their role allows
acceptance: profile_members holds Admin, Developer and Finance members of merchant profiles (never the owner), and Developer and Finance members have assigned stores; GET /v1/me lists the profiles a user belongs to with their role (owner, admin, developer, finance)

Every {profileId} route asks for one permission from one map in code (auth), never a role name, and a test fails when a route has none; a user who is neither owner nor member gets 403, and a member without the route's permission gets 403

Developer and Finance see only their stores: store and invoice lists, events and Owed leave the rest out, another store's invoice or store is 404, and create defaults to their first store and refuses another with 422; jobs are Admin only and notifications the owner's
R-138, D-93, api.md, openapi.yaml and architecture.md describe it; required checks and backend-e2e pass
notes: 2026-10-25 review fail by reviewer: BLOCKING: (1) apps/backend/internal/profile/signup.go:43-51 (via profile/list.go:16): SignUp and Onboard now repair wallets on member profiles with the member's Privy ID. Reproduced with a go -overlay test: a member's POST /v1/me on the owner's walletless merchant profile created a Privy wallet owned by the member and stored it in profile_wallets. The member would control the profile's receiving wallet (breaks D-61, D-46). Repair only profiles with Role owner. (2) apps/backend/internal/httpapi/invoiceapi/invoices.go:42-63 with internal/invoice/create.go:243 and :330: create's replaces names any invoice of the profile with no store check. Reproduced: a Developer of store B got 201 with replaces={invoiceId, number} of a store-A invoice, and that invoice was canceled. Refuse a replaced invoice outside access.Stores. (3) internal/httpapi/tests/members_test.go:112: the events and Owed store filters (invoice/events.go:37, owed.go:45 and :55) have no test; removing them passes every test, so acceptance 3 is unproven there. NON-BLOCKING: auth/access.go:88 array_agg has no ORDER BY, so a member's 'first store' default is arbitrary; order by stores.created_at, id like the owner's default. profile/list.go:16 the OR EXISTS join can't use the profiles.user_id index, so GET /v1/me and signup scan every profile; use a UNION. Finance sees every store's invoices (ids, numbers, amounts, client names) through activity, transactions, the CSV and statement.pdf; D-93 lists these for Finance but D-30 says Finance sees its assigned stores; record which one applies. A Developer sets a store's tokensOff through PUT store (StoresWrite), but D-93 says only Admin manages token switches; record it or gate it. An owner's cross-store revision still shows the replaced invoice's id and number to the other store's members. Stale docs: docs/backend/api.md:564-565 (RequireProfileOwner, ProfileScoped), api/openapi.yaml:1585 ('the signed-in user owns'), docs/backend/rules.md:21, auth/auth.go:1, and 'user owns the profile' comments at invoice/list.go:48, events.go:27, owed.go:28. D-84: docs/backend/api.md:547-548 is 30 words. The auth import sits in the stdlib group in invoiceapi, jobapi, moneyapi and profileapi routes.go. Structure: mid importing invoice and profile for not-found errors is fine (httpio does the same, no cycle); auth.InvoiceStore reads invoices from auth, which is acceptable but optional to move. CheckAccess SQL, the nil-versus-empty store list (the idle Developer case is tested), List, trigger, migration Down, the route-guard test and the removal of CheckProfileOwner are correct. Requested tests pass.

2026-10-25 review pass by reviewer: Re-review after fixes: no blocking findings. Fixed: profile/signup.go:45 repairs wallets only on owned profiles; invoice/create.go:330 replace() refuses an old invoice outside Request.Stores (404); events.go:37 and owed.go:45/55 filters are now tested. I checked by mutation through go -overlay, with no repo edits: turning off each of the events filter, both Owed filters, the replace store check, the signup owner check, the TokensFixed check, the invoice list filter and the store list filter makes TestMembersReachOnlyWhatTheirRoleAllows or TestMemberSignUpMakesNoWalletForTheirTeamsProfile fail. Clean run passes: httpapi/tests (members, owed, tokens, stores, route guards), invoice, profile and auth packages; gofmt, go vet and docs-check are clean. CheckAccess orders the stores by created_at, id; profile.List uses UNION ALL; SaveStore compares tokensOff inside the profile-locked transaction; profile importing auth adds no cycle. Docs match the code: R-138, D-93, api.md, openapi, rules.md, architecture.md. NON-BLOCKING: (1) An owner's Revise into another store still shows that store's members the replaced invoice's id and number, in replaces and in the history row's related. (2) The D-93 lines on jobs, notifications and the shared wallet are agent defaults; the owner should confirm them, mainly that Finance sees every store's activity and transactions while D-30 says assigned stores. (3) A Developer's ordinary store save still drops store_tokens_off rows for tokens that are now disabled; owners' saves already did this. (4) tests/invoices_owed_test.go:15: the R-95 tag now sits on the deposit helper, and TestOwedToYou lost it. (5) The default store order (first by created_at) is not tested with two assigned stores. (6) The web will show member profiles from GET /v1/me with pages that answer 403; F295 should handle that.

2026-10-25 review pass by reviewer: Re-review after the R-95 tag fix: invoices_owed_test.go has the // R-95. tag back above TestOwedToYou, and the deposit helper carries only its own comment. No blocking findings. The earlier non-blocking notes stand: an owner's cross-store Revise shows the replaced invoice's id and number to the other store's members; the owner should confirm D-93's agent defaults (jobs, notifications, and Finance seeing every store's activity under the shared wallet); a Developer's store save drops store_tokens_off rows for disabled tokens, as owners' saves already did; the first-store order is untested with two assigned stores; the web will show member profiles whose pages answer 403 (F295).

tasks.behavior: A merchant invites team members by email and manages their roles
acceptance: Invites are single use, hashed, bound to the invited email and expire in 7 days; the invited user accepts at /invite/<token> signed in with that verified email; an Admin changes roles and stores with a fresh sign-in (D-63) and removes members; a member leaves; the last Admin can't leave or be demoted; the Team page lists members and invites; the app hides pages a role can't use
